# mouse_input

`mouse_input::component` installs and manages Windows/raw-mouse hooks, cursor hiding, gamepad activity tracking, and raw-input synchronization for game mouse input.

## Contents

- [mouse_input.cpp](./mouse_input.cpp) — Defines `mouse_input::component`, hook installation and teardown, `wnd_proc_stub`, `mouse_event_body`, `mouse_event_callsite_stub`, raw-input registration, and original-call bridges.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`post_load()` schedules a `scheduler::loop` on `scheduler::main` every `100ms`, allowing `install_hooks_if_ready()`, `install_wnd_proc_if_ready()`, and `update_raw_input_state()` to coordinate callsite patching, window-procedure replacement, and raw-input registration.

`install_hooks_if_ready()` waits for `is_window_ready()` across 10 consecutive ticks, snapshots 5 bytes at `game::game_offset(0x102C3934)`, and patches the callsite with `mouse_event_callsite_stub`.

`wnd_proc_stub()` handles `WM_ACTIVATEAPP`, `WM_MOUSEMOVE`, `WM_SETCURSOR`, and `WM_INPUT`, while `mouse_event_body()` merges raw deltas, cursor visibility, key-catcher state, and gamepad activity before forwarding through `call_original_mouse_event_stub()`.

## Lifecycle Contracts

`REGISTER_COMPONENT(mouse_input::component)` owns component registration, `pre_destroy()` calls `uninstall_wnd_proc()` and `restore_mouse_event_callsite()`, and `post_load()` registers equivalent cleanup through `scheduler::on_shutdown`.

`install_wnd_proc_if_ready()` requires `callsite_patched`, a valid `HWND`, and `dvars::m_rawInput`; `uninstall_wnd_proc()` unregisters raw input and restores `original_wnd_proc`.

`restore_mouse_event_callsite()` restores the exact 5-byte `original_mouse_event_call`; `update_raw_input_state()` follows `dvars::m_rawInput->current.enabled`.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `register_raw_input()` uses mouse usage page `0x01`, usage `0x02`, and `RIDEV_INPUTSINK`.
- `unregister_raw_input()` uses `RIDEV_REMOVE` and clears `raw_mouse_x` and `raw_mouse_y`.
- `wnd_proc_stub()` resets `raw_mouse_x` and `raw_mouse_y` on inactive `WM_ACTIVATEAPP`.
- `wnd_proc_stub()` reports `WM_MOUSEMOVE` activity when raw input is disabled.
- `wnd_proc_stub()` returns `TRUE` after `SetCursor(nullptr)` for hidden cursors on `WM_SETCURSOR`.
- `wnd_proc_stub()` accumulates `RIM_TYPEMOUSE` deltas from `WM_INPUT` through `GetRawInputData`.
- `mouse_event_body()` suppresses events when `gamepad::should_hide_cursor()` is true.
- `mouse_event_body()` bypasses ordinary activity reporting when `raw_input_registered` or `*game::keyCatchers & 0x10` applies.
- `mouse_event_body()` substitutes `raw_mouse_x - old_x` and `raw_mouse_y - old_y` only when raw input is enabled, the window is foreground, `*game::keyCatchers & 0x10` is clear, and raw deltas are nonzero.
- `mouse_event_callsite_stub()` is a naked x86 `__cdecl` bridge preserving `esi`, `edi`, and `ebx`.
- `call_original_mouse_event_stub()` invokes `original_mouse_event_address = game::game_offset(0x102FD5D0)` through `original_call_state` and records `original_call_result`.

## State

`mouse_event_state` carries `int x`, `y`, `dx`, and `dy`; `callsite_patched`, `wnd_proc_hooked`, `raw_input_registered`, `ready_ticks`, `raw_mouse_x`, `raw_mouse_y`, `pending_event`, `original_call_state`, and `original_call_result` maintain process-local hook state.
